answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9132 Country: India Title: Can a permanent tooth be fixed in the event of tooth removal or broken tooth. Also, can we fix artificial ENAMEL to strengethen the gums and tooth which will become sensitive and weak?? Question: As'salmu alaikum. Can a permanent tooth be fixed in the event of tooth removal or broken tooth. Also, can we fix artificial ENAMEL to strengethen the gums and tooth which will become sensitive and weak?? Answer ID: 9132 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2481/2051=B/1429) You can do both the things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
